items.text: Ndakateelela kale kanjikanji zintu zili boobo; Nyoonse muli baumbulizi bakatezi biyo.
Pele, nekuba ndaamba, buusu bwangu tabucesegwi;
Akwalo kukotela kwangu kulaamba kubusyu bwangu!
Bandiumide seya cakusampula, Kababungene kuti bandilwanye.
Pele lino kuli kamboni kale kujulu,
Pele misozi yangu ilalanga kuli-Leza mukukomba,
Kuti aiminine muntu kunembo lyakwe mwini,
